note: Authored expectation-level mutation coverage; this is not a claim of mutation coverage against the Go implementation.

D05.defect: All-fee net equals raw trade.pnl (entry debit missing from the net)

D06.defect: Win or loss decided on gross P&L or raw trade.pnl instead of all-fee net

D07.defect: A zero-net trade counted as a win, or not as non-winning

D08.defect: Hypothetical exit fee or exit slippage subtracted from an open-position mark

D09.defect: Open-position unrealized P&L left out of the mark (cash-only equity)

D10.defect: Entry fee debit left out of the mark while the position is open

D11.defect: Short-side unrealized P&L has the wrong sign

D12.defect: An extra equity mark after legacy final-bar liquidation

D13.defect: Final mark not replaced by the post-liquidation value

D14.defect: Liquidation without exit fee or exit slippage

D15.defect: Stale drawdown peak: never raised, or raised only at trade closes

D17.defect: Percent drawdown taken at the bar of the maximum currency drawdown

D18.defect: Percent drawdown measured against start equity instead of the peak

D20.defect: Genuine zero reported as unavailable (all-flat, flat-only losses, zero drawdown)

D21.defect: Negative equity clamped, or drawdown above 100 percent clamped

D22.defect: Start equity input 0 not normalized to 10000, or a negative input accepted

D23.defect: Marks not exactly one per original bar

D24.defect: Same-bar exit and re-entry blocked or marked twice

D25.defect: Hold bars off by one, or a same-bar hold not zero

D27.defect: Return percent on the wrong base

D28.defect: Worst loss without its zero floor, or from the wrong quantity

D29.defect: Streak errors (a flat resets the non-winning streak)

D30.defect: Fractional position size truncated or rounded

D31.defect: Negative zero exported (only a raw -0 that a product with the short sign can produce; see leg.liq_zero_costs_flat)

D32.defect: Incomplete terminal run liquidated, or partial result returned with the refusal

D33.defect: Nonfinite value exported as zero or as a success

D34.defect: Exit level wrong: stop gap fill ignored, or exit slippage dropped

omit_entry_fee.description: No entry fee is debited (fee 0 on entry; exit fee unchanged)

double_entry_fee.description: The entry fee is debited twice

double_exit_fee.description: The exit fee is charged twice

net_equals_trade_pnl.description: tradeAccounting netPnl and win/loss use the exit credit (entry fee not subtracted); account net is still the realized balance

win_by_gross.description: A trade is a win when gross P&L > 0

win_by_trade_pnl.description: A trade is a win when the exit credit (trade.pnl) > 0

zero_is_win.description: A trade with net >= 0 is a win

mark_charges_exit_cost.description: An open mark also subtracts the exit fee and the exit slippage

mark_cash_only.description: Marks use start + realized only (no unrealized)

mark_ignores_entry_fee.description: Marks add the open position's entry fee back

short_mark_sign.description: Short unrealized P&L is (close - entry) * size

extra_final_mark.description: An extra mark is appended after a liquidation

final_mark_not_replaced.description: The final mark keeps the pre-liquidation value

liquidation_no_exit_cost.description: Liquidation has no exit fee and no exit slippage

peak_never_raised.description: The drawdown peak stays at the initial equity

peak_raised_on_close_only.description: The peak is raised only by the realized balance at a trade close, not by marks

pct_at_max_currency_dd.description: maxDDpct is the percent at the bar of the maximum currency drawdown

pct_vs_start_equity.description: Percent drawdown is drawdown / start equity * 100

unavailable_as_zero.description: Every null ratio is reported as 0

zero_as_unavailable.description: All-flat profit factor and flat-only average loss are null; zero drawdown is null

clamp_negative_equity.description: Marks and totals below zero are clamped to 0, and percent drawdown to 100

start_zero_not_normalized.description: Start equity 0 is used as 0, a negative input is accepted

skip_flat_marks.description: A mark is written only when the position or the realized balance changed

block_same_bar_reentry.description: A signal on a bar where the position just exited is dropped

hold_bars_plus_one.description: avgHoldBars counts exit - entry + 1 and hold_bars likewise

net_excludes_fees.description: Account net is the sum of gross P&L

worst_loss_no_floor.description: worstLoss is the minimum net with no zero floor

flat_resets_loss_streak.description: A zero-net trade resets the non-winning streak

truncate_size.description: Position size is rounded down to an integer

negative_zero_exported.description: Exact zero values of a short position are exported as "-0"

terminal_liquidates.description: A held Full position at the end of data is liquidated at the last close instead of refused

partial_result_on_refusal.description: A refusal also carries the marks computed so far

overflow_as_zero.description: A nonfinite fee, equity or net is treated as 0 and the run succeeds

exit_no_slippage.description: Exit fills carry no slippage (entry still does)

stop_gap_ignored.description: A stop gap fills at the stop level, not the worse open
